headline: After killer quarter, Palantir CEO Alex Karp calls AI industry ‘Marxist’
context: After a quarter that delivered $1 billion in profit, Palantir CEO Alex Karp on Monday once again warned that AI frontier labs are too untrustworthy for enterprises.
